name: Search for Geonames
description:
Add an address as seed node, e.g. "Ernst-Lohmeyer-Platz 3, 17487 Greifswald, Germany". Fetch data.

You need to register at http://www.geonames.org/ and enable the API in your account settings. Then enter your username into the access token field.

Documentation: https://www.geonames.org/maps/addresses.html#geoCodeAddress

See http://www.geonames.org/export/web-services.html for an overview about Geonames APIs.
